label: OW04_HTTP8_RACE6_WORKFLOW_BOUNDED_FINAL_COUNTER
scope: Only HTTP evidence preservation, fresh AB clone dependency and race ordering, plus both artifact paths.

checks.scenario: HTTP8 succeeds and package.run removes cp6_rollback before race6.
checks.expected: A separate fresh AB clone exists before race package installation; existing outer cleanup stays enabled.
checks.observed_source: A new intervening step follows HTTP and precedes race. It runs the same clone tool with source postgres, template1 maintenance, cp6_rollback target and supabase_db_cp5-local, with distinct CLONE_race_install evidence prefix. The package still drops its own clone and requires primary_unchanged before command success, so the second clone uses the retained aligned AB primary.

checks.scenario: Race package and drill write the same t3 report filenames used by HTTP.
checks.expected: The completed full HTTP proof tree remains separately available before race starts.
checks.observed_source: Before the new clone, shutil.copytree copies the entire t3 tree into sibling ow04-http-completed. No dirs_exist_ok option is enabled, so an existing destination causes refusal instead of overwrite. This runs as its own normal success-conditioned workflow step after successful HTTP; failures prevent the later race step.

checks.scenario: Race succeeds or fails after HTTP evidence was preserved.
checks.expected: Artifact includes preserved HTTP package/drill proof and current race proof.
checks.observed_source: The always upload step now includes both auditor/cp6-proof/t3 and auditor/cp6-proof/ow04-http-completed, retaining the original HTTP tree beside race outputs. Always disposable-runtime cleanup remains before the artifact step.

checks.scenario: HTTP8 and race6 share one disposable runtime bootstrap.
checks.expected: One bootstrap can support both entries while each receives its own aligned AB clone and retains its own gates.
checks.observed_source: The original initial clone step remains, a second allowlisted clone is inserted between the entries, and no backend, case module, entrypoint or frozen expected bytes changed from the initial source assessment.

limits: Source assessment only; no DB/HTTP/race/Native execution or CI PASS claim.
Does not repeat the broader initial race or HTTP case inventory.
No new product or financial acceptance claim.
